meta.title: Pricing & engagement models: fixed outcome or embedded team
meta.description: How Viewnear engagements are scoped and priced (fixed cost, time & materials, or team augmentation), plus what drives cost. Scope and price agreed up front.

hero.title: Clear scope. <hl>No surprises.</hl>
hero.description: Engagements are scoped to the data and goals at hand, and priced up front, whichever model fits. Here's how we structure the work and what shapes the investment.

modelsHeading.title: Engagement models
modelsHeading.intro: Flexible ways to partner, matched to the shape of the problem: fixed-outcome delivery, flex capacity, or a dedicated team embedded in yours.

engagementModels.title: Fixed cost
engagementModels.body: A defined scope, timeline, and price agreed up front: fixed-outcome delivery, priced to the result rather than the hours. Best when the outcome is clear and budget certainty matters from day one.

engagementModels.title: Time & materials
engagementModels.body: Flexible, iterative delivery billed by effort against a shared backlog. Ideal for evolving requirements and discovery-led work.

engagementModels.title: Dedicated team & staff augmentation
engagementModels.body: Embed our certified practitioners alongside the in-house team, as a dedicated team or a team extension. We accelerate delivery while leveling up their capability.

workedExample.body: The shape of a typical first engagement: a discovery fixes scope and price, sprint demos show working software from the first weeks, and a governed foundation reaches production in 8–16 weeks, with a named team the sponsor meets before signing and in-house people in the work from sprint one.

cost.title: Priced to the work, not a sticker
cost.intro: We don't publish one-size pricing because no two engagements are the same. Cost is shaped by:

costFactors: Data volume and the number/complexity of source systems
How many analytics and AI use cases are in scope

impactByPhase.title: Foundations & first value
impactByPhase.body: The data practice stands up: scope fixed in discovery, governance designed in from the first table, priority data flowing, and the first governed data products in production.

impactByPhase.title: Scale & self-service
impactByPhase.body: The AI practice ships: use cases spread across teams and each new one reaches first insight 60% faster. Self-service takes hold; manual reporting retires.

impactByPhase.title: Compounding advantage
impactByPhase.body: Both practices are in-house: new use cases ship in weeks at 40% lower run cost, and the handover is real. The team runs and extends the work without us.

cta.title: Let's scope it together.
cta.subtitle: Tell us the goals and constraints, and we'll come back with a model, a plan, and a price ready for the board.

nearshoreLink.title: Whichever model fits, the team is nearshore and on your hours.
